acme_sarah: Hey team — hitting a 400 from the /rerank endpoint with error "embedding dimension mismatch". It only happens when I send batches of 5 candidates. Single-candidate calls succeed. Request ID from response header: req-abc123. Model in use: embed-lite-1536. Payload shape I'm sending below. Can someone help repro?

maya_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl you used and the full response body (including headers)? also confirm the content of the embeddings array (are they arrays of floats or base64 strings?).

acme_sarah: here's the minimal curl I used (sanitized token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query_embedding": [0.12, 0.34, ...], "candidate_embeddings": [[0.11,0.22,...],[0.13,0.24,...],[0.14,0.25,...],[0.15,0.26,...],[0.16,0.27,...]]}'
```
Response (400): {"error":"embedding dimension mismatch","request_id":"req-abc123"}

maya_support: thanks — two quick checks: 1) are all candidate vectors the exact same length as the query vector? 2) are there any `null` or string values inside the arrays? can you paste the first two vectors (full numeric arrays) so we can compare lengths?

acme_sarah: i printed them and the query has length 1536, but the 3rd candidate shows 1535 (one value missing) — this was from a downstream batcher.

dan_engineer: that explains it. rerank expects identical dims for query + all candidates. common failure when batching trims trailing values. steps to repro locally: 1) reproduce the bad batch (one vector shorter) 2) call the endpoint with single vs batched payload to see different behavior. try this minimal repro: 
```
# good (single candidate)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query_embedding": [0.1,0.2,0.3], "candidate_embeddings": [[0.1,0.2,0.3]]}'

# bad (one candidate shorter)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query_embedding": [0.1,0.2,0.3], "candidate_embeddings": [[0.1,0.2,0.3],[0.1,0.2]]}'
```
You should get a 400 with dimension mismatch for the bad one.

maya_support: for our debug bundle, can you collect the request/response pair and the app-side batcher logs for `req-abc123`? you can also trigger our support debug collector: 
```
curl -X GET "https://api.redwood.example/support/debug-bundle?request_id=req-abc123" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -o debug_bundle_req-abc123.zip
```
That bundle will include server-side traces (if available) and will help us pinpoint whether the server accepted inconsistent shapes or failed earlier in the pipeline.

acme_sarah: running the collector now, uploading `debug_bundle_req-abc123.zip` to the ticket. also pushed a fix in our batcher to pad vectors or drop malformed entries.

dan_engineer: thanks — one more proactive suggestion: validate vector lengths before sending. if you need a quick client-side check snippet: 
```python
def validate_batch(query, candidates):
    L = len(query)
    for i,c in enumerate(candidates):
        if len(c) != L:
            raise ValueError(f\"candidate {i} length {len(c)} != query length {L}\")
```

ingest-bot: Uploaded debug bundle `debug_bundle_req-abc123.zip` to support ticket #4521 (signed URL valid for 48h).

maya_support: received bundle, we'll run a quick trace and follow up with root cause and a sanity-check patch for batching logic. thanks for the fast repro and the curl examples — that helped a lot :thumbsup:

acme_sarah: thanks everyone — fix confirmed on our side, rerun of full suite passes. will close ticket after you confirm server logs look clean.
